content.text: Night waking does happen at 8, and it's usually tied to busy-brain stuff like worries, a change in routine, or summer bedtimes drifting later. Tonight, try a short wind-down in the last 20 minutes before bed. Have her tell you one worry and one good thing from her day, then lights out. If she wakes at 2am, keep it boring and calm: walk her back to bed with no screens and no chat. If it keeps up for weeks or she seems really anxious, mention it to her doctor.
